install: touch "$HOME/.bashrc" && sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.venv/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.venv/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.venv/bin:$PATH"; [ -x "$HOME/.venv/bin/python" ] || python3 -m venv "$HOME/.venv"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv pip install --python "$HOME/.venv/bin/python" -r requirements.txt; else "$HOME/.venv/bin/pip" install --no-input -r requirements.txt; fi; pwd > "$("$HOME/.venv/bin/python" -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_path("purelib"))')/finpulse.pth"
